newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber sees net profit in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber sees net profit in 1996.

text.p: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber, which lost 170.5 million yuan in 1995, expects a net profit of up to 20 million yuan in 1996 according to international accounting standards, an official said on Thursday.
Using Chinese accounting standards, the company will make a net profit of 140 million yuan in 1996, up from 7.92 million in 1995, the company official, contacted by telephone, said.
In the first 10 months, the company made a profit of 117 million yuan on domestic accounting standards, the China Securities newspaper said on Thursday.
The profit rise was partly due to the company's efforts to expand domestic sales, the official said.
The company has set up about 30 sale offices around the country, up from 16 by the end of 1995, and the number will reach 100 over the next year, he added.

A local broker said that Shanghai Tyre & Rubber's results for 1996 would be much better after the losses of the past two years mainly due to cheaper raw materials and support from the Shanghai city government.
